overview: Fictional support queries. No ontology required. Query parameters never establish customer access rights.

entries.name: Customer orders
entries.description: List all orders for a customer during an internal support task. Includes cancelled orders. Customer ID is not an authorization claim.

template.query_json: {"query": "SELECT id AS order_id, status, amount::text AS amount, currency, placed_at FROM support_demo.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY id", "params": [1]}

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Internal customer identifier; database account permissions set the actual access scope.

template.result_description: One row per order; exact decimal amount as text with currency. No rows means no orders for this customer. Does not subtract refunds.

entries.name: Order refund status
entries.description: Inspect refund requests for a known order. Settled is complete; this query does not initiate or change refunds.

template.query_json: {"query": "SELECT id AS refund_id, order_id, status, amount::text AS amount, currency FROM support_demo.refunds WHERE order_id = $1 ORDER BY id", "params": [101]}

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: Order identifier from the order lookup.

template.result_description: One row per refund request with exact decimal amount as text. An empty result means no recorded refund, not a zero-valued settled refund.

entries.name: Paid order total in USD
entries.description: Sum gross USD order amounts for paid orders placed in a UTC interval. Excludes cancelled orders; settled refunds are not deducted. This is not net revenue.
entries.time_definition: placed_at >= from and placed_at < until; UTC.
entries.caveats: Gross amount, not net revenue. Refunds are not deducted. Live data may change between separate calls.

template.query_json: {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0)::text AS amount, 'USD' AS currency FROM support_demo.orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND currency = 'USD' AND placed_at >= $1::timestamptz AND placed_at < $2::timestamptz", "params": ["2026-09-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-09-04T00:00:00Z"]}

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 UTC placement time, later than from.

template.result_description: One aggregate row: paid_orders, exact amount string, USD currency. No matches returns a zero count and amount. Interval is based on placement, not settlement time.
